### What I want

When `npx ai-task-manager init` binds a GitHub Project board, verify that its fields and option values match AITM's requirements, including the Priority field. If the board is incompatible, identify what needs repair before completing the binding. This could use an AITM doctor check or validation within init.

### Why it matters

A fresh install can bind to GitHub's default Priority field, which lacks AITM's priority values. The resulting board configuration does not work correctly and requires manual recovery.

### Notes

I encountered this after a fresh install. I deleted the incompatible Priority field and reran `npx ai-task-manager init` to reconfigure the task-tracker binding.
